title: Cloud sandboxes for AI agents, explained
description: A plain-language guide to cloud sandbox providers for people running AI agents: what each feature means, what to check, and who to pick for which situation.

confidenceTags.meaning: The provider's own documentation says it at the linked page.
The provider's pricing page or a money-specific page says it.
Someone other than the provider said it, such as battleships.dev or a review.
Our reading of documented facts. Not a sentence the provider wrote.
We looked and found no statement. We do not guess.

limits: This is desk research. No provider account was created and no sandbox was started or billed, so every claim about behaviour is a documentation claim, not something we measured.
Prices are the providers' published list rates in US dollars on 2026-10-28, excluding tax. Several providers changed prices during October 2026, so a number here can be out of date within weeks.
Where a provider publishes nothing, the site says 'not published' rather than estimating. Where two pages of the same provider disagree, the site shows both and marks it as a contradiction.

battleships.dev is a comparison dataset built by the Boat (boat.dev) team. We used it as a cross-check, never as a primary source, and it disagreed with live provider pages often enough that its own numbers are not repeated here as fact.
